$comment: COMPANY_SCHEMA for thesis-data.js entries — same shape the original 8 configs were authored with (workflow thesis-build). All Thai text natural; numbers approximate with ~.

fundamentals.$comment: EXACTLY these keys in this order: revenueGrowth, epsGrowth, fcf, margin, roic, cash, debt, dilution, capitalAllocation, valuation. valuation score = price attractiveness (cheap = high).

whatChanged.$comment: most recent reported quarter vs the prior one

$quarterFields.$comment: history.quarters[] rows accept two OPTIONAL verification fields (added 2026-08): 'endDate' = exact period-end date YYYY-MM-DD (NEVER derive it from endYm — fiscal quarters do not always end on calendar month-end, e.g. NVDA ends Apr 26 / Jul 26); 'epsNote' = one-line Thai explanation when that quarter's EPS contains a one-time item (investment gain, impairment, tax settlement) so cross-quarter comparison is not misread. Both render in the §6 quarterly table; omit rather than guess.

nextEarnings.$comment: OPTIONAL. Next expected quarterly report. YYYY-MM-DD = company-confirmed date; YYYY-MM = estimated month (shown with ~). Drives the earnings-aware reload reminder.

forwardView.$comment: OPTIONAL top-level forward-looking layer (consensus + guidance track record). Tickers without it must keep working unchanged. Has its OWN asOf — consensus ages faster than structural data. Never guess numbers: unverifiable fields stay null / rows omitted. No Buy/Sell wording anywhere.

asOf.$comment: asOf of THIS block — must be equal to or newer than the company-level asOf

estimateHistory.$comment: APPEND-ONLY consensus revision trail. Refresh appends ONE row per run — never edit or delete existing rows. If the new row's asOf equals the latest row's asOf, replace that single row (same-month re-run guard). When consensus rolls to a new fy (e.g. FY2026 -> FY2027), start new fy rows appended at the end and KEEP all old-fy rows. Over 16 rows: drop the oldest. asOf ascending, no duplicate asOf.

revenue.$comment: USD billions (keep the unit consistent per ticker)

guidanceTrack.$comment: Newest quarter FIRST. Max 12 rows. No duplicate (quarter, metric) pair. magnitudePct = % distance of actual from the guidance-range midpoint (single-value guidance = that value); result must be consistent with magnitudePct — inline means within +/-1% of midpoint. Quarters where the company gave no guidance for that metric get result=noGuidance (record the row, do not skip it).

quarter.$comment: e.g. 2026Q2 (company fiscal labeling allowed, keep consistent per ticker)

guided.$comment: guidance text as announced, ~ prefix for approximations, e.g. ~$47-50B

magnitudePct.$comment: REQUIRED as a number whenever result is not noGuidance

consensus.$comment: Forward fiscal years ONLY — fy must be newer than the latest fiscal year that already has actuals. Typically the next 2 FYs.

confidence.$comment: high = multiple analyst sources agree; medium = single source; low = derived from company guidance only

basis.$comment: OPTIONAL. Accounting basis of the consensus EPS. Default when absent = unknown. NEVER guess — if the source does not state the basis, use unknown. UI joins the consensus EPS dash-line to actuals ONLY when basis matches the KB epsBasis; unknown/mismatch renders disconnected points.

note.$comment: 1-2 Thai sentences — e.g. why consensus was revised, or a change in how guidance is given
